title: A CI job does not start when no file its suites read changed
why: Ruled but not built: decision test-strategy-reset says "Each CI job runs only when a file that its suites read changes" (also decision ci-cut-in-steps, item 31). Built today, jobs always start and only steps skip (.github/workflows/checks.yml line 39), so a prose-only batch still starts about 19 jobs (retrospective 11:19 CST Nov 13, after an owner question relayed by runner 10 at 11:17 CST).
source: retrospective 11:19 CST Nov 13; runner 10 measures batch 133's job minutes
note: Blocker to weigh: a job-level skip needs the all-jobs-passed rollup (lint/all_jobs_passed_rules.py) to accept a skipped job, which the coordinator's 14:25 CST Nov 12 pick (step guard-pr-runs-windows-shards) avoided as a widening of a check. The lane shows the rollup still fails on a job that should have run and was skipped, red then green. First measure: runner 10's job minutes for batch 133 against a prose-only batch. A CI fix, allowed under ruling drain-first-hold. Folded into step ci-skip-untouched-steps (coordinator 11:21 CST Nov 13): the same ruled-but-unbuilt skip, with the owner's wider scope (the checks job's unflagged pull_request lint steps). Carry its blocker note there.
